intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Apple Valley for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, none of them free. Santa Claus Is Coming to the Zoo runs Saturdays November 28 and December 5, 12 and 19 at the Minnesota Zoo, and the Zoo's Home for the Holidays weekend on December 5 and 6 brings back the Japanese macaques and the Clydesdales, both included with admission. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Apple Valley

  • 2 Christmas events for kids in Apple Valley
  • 0 free events: both are included with Zoo admission ($19.95 ages 3 to 12, ages 2 and under free)
  • Meet Santa: outside the Gift Shop, Saturdays 10:30 am to noon
  • Parades and tree lightings: the city's tree lighting was November 24
  • Trains: none verified in Apple Valley
  • Season: November 28 to December 19, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Apple Valley families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Minneapolis, which covers the Orpheum and Guthrie holiday shows, the CPKC Holiday Train, Christkindl Market and the Minnesota Streetcar Museum.
celebrates: Apple Valley's Christmas season centers on the Minnesota Zoo and the city's own ceremony. The City of Apple Valley holds its annual Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony at the Municipal Center at 6:15 pm on the Tuesday before the council meeting, which this year was November 24. At the Minnesota Zoo, Santa Claus waits outside the Gift Shop on four Saturdays, and the Zoo's Home for the Holidays weekend on December 5 and 6 brings back the Japanese macaques and the Clydesdales.
lastyear: The City of Apple Valley's calendar calls its tree lighting the 40th annual Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony, which means the city has held it for four decades. This year's ceremony took place November 24, before this page was published, so it is not listed as an event. We did not find a published recap of last year's ceremony or of the Zoo's 2025 Santa Saturdays, so this page leaves out last year's turnout.
facts: The Minnesota Zoo is at 13000 Zoo Boulevard and, according to its Plan a Visit page, is open from 10 am to 4 pm with tickets sold for daytime visits through February 28, 2027. Santa visits are included with admission, and the Zoo's ticket calendar lists daily Royal Credit Union Sea Lion Discovery shows at 11 am and 2 pm. The city's tree lighting is held at the Municipal Center at 7100 147th Street West.
trains: Apple Valley has no train ride that we could verify this season. The CPKC Holiday Train stops at Depot Park in Hastings on December 12 from 8:45 to 9:15 pm, according to the City of Hastings, and the Twin City Model Railroad Museum in Saint Paul lists daytime visits at 10 dollars and Night Trains at 15 dollars, with children 4 and under free, according to its Rally Takes the Train page.

faq: How does Apple Valley celebrate Christmas?
The city holds an annual Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony at the Municipal Center, and the Minnesota Zoo has Santa on four Saturdays and a Home for the Holidays weekend on December 5 and 6.
When is Santa at the Minnesota Zoo?
Saturdays, November 28 and December 5, 12 and 19, 2026, from 10:30 am to noon outside the Gift Shop.
The Zoo lists $19.95 for ages 3 to 12, and children ages 2 and under are free. Santa is included.
Is there a tree lighting in Apple Valley?
The city's 40th annual ceremony was on November 24 at the Municipal Center, so it has passed this year.
